candidate.title: hMeDIP-Seq
candidate.scope: Architecture of the middle hMeDIP-Seq row in the assigned Illumina crop, from hydroxymethylated genomic DNA to purified immunoenriched DNA, with the text-supported sequencing interface explained at its endpoint. The card title and the matching secondary page identify hMeDIP-Seq as the target. The top MeDIP-Seq/DIP-seq row, partially clipped bottom MBDCap-seq/Methyl-Cap-seq row, clipped captions at the upper margin and pyridine sidebar belong to neighboring catalogue material; no arrow connects them to the hMeDIP row. They are not alternative routes of this assigned assay. No chemical end groups, adapters, barcodes or compartments are specified by the hMeDIP drawing.

operations.label: DNA purification
operations.description: Recover DNA from the immunoprecipitated material, yielding purified enriched fragments without depicted antibody attachment. The two arrow glyphs belong to this single population-level recovery; neither a split destination nor branch-specific product is labelled.
operations.information_effect: The enriched genomic DNA remains the physical readout carrier: its genomic sequence is associated with prior anti-5hmC selection. In the Xu implementation the retained fragments were adapter-ligated before hMeDIP and subsequently sequenced with standard Illumina protocols. The catalogue identifies the downstream sequencing-library interface, while the diagram ends at purified DNA. Reads report regional enrichment for 5hmC-containing fragments; they do not identify the exact modified cytosine within a fragment, and enrichment alone does not establish absolute 5hmC stoichiometry. Antibody specificity and selectivity limit biological specificity. No PCR, sequencing instrument, read layout, or adapter-end chemistry is drawn.
